quote: You hide behind a quiet smile because you are afraid to burden the people you love. You carry heavy grief in silence while the world expects you to keep moving forward. Nobody notices the silent battles you fight inside your mind every single day. You give away all your energy just to keep everyone else safe and warm. But your own spirit is slowly freezing in the cold dark. Stop trying to rescue everyone else before you have even learned how to save yourself.
